note: Each change is defined as a pair of measured conditions; the effect is computed from results/t1_summary.csv so it cannot drift from the data. memory_delta_gib is the 128k-context peak difference measured in results/kv_footprint.json, or 0 where the change costs no memory.

comparisons.label: decompose the prompt into a checklist
comparisons.comment: Measured on qwen3.8:27b, the model the paper foregrounds and one of the seven that produce output under both prompt forms. The effect is not uniform: among those seven it ranges from -2 to +11, and models that return nothing under free-form gain more only because they start at zero.
